name: Landman
description: Set in the proverbial boomtowns of West-Texas and a modern-day tale of fortune-seeking in the world of oil rigs, the series is an upstairs/downstairs story of roughnecks and wildcat billionaires that are fueling a boom so big it’s reshaping our climate, our economy and our geopolitics.

videos.title: What to Expect
videos.overview: Find out everything you need to know about Landman, a new series from Taylor Sheridan, the Executive Producer of Yellowstone. Featuring Billy Bob Thornton, Ali Larter, with Demi Moore, and Jon Hamm, the series takes viewers inside the larger-than-life world of West Texas oil.

videos.title: Constant Crisis: The Path to Landman
videos.overview: A half-hour general rundown of the show, world, and characters with cast and crew interviews.

videos.title: Passion and Poise: Tommy & Angela / Cami & Monty
videos.overview: A featurette on the 2 couples.

videos.title: Welcome to the Patch: Pyrotechnics and Stunts
videos.overview: Discover the action, special effects, and stunts during the oil rig scenes.

videos.title: Landman: Meet the Millers
videos.overview: Jon Hamm and Demi Moore talk about their Monty and Cami characters and the series.

videos.title: Landman: The Best of Tommy
videos.overview: A highlight reel of Billy Bob Thornton's character.

videos.title: Roughnecking It with Billy, James, and Jacob
videos.overview: Billy Bob Thronton, Jacob James, and Jacob Lofland show off tools of the trade and talk about the job.

videos.title: Digging Deep with the Cast of Landman
videos.overview: Cast members answer random questions.

videos.title: Landman
videos.overview: A modern tale of fortune seeking amongst roughnecks and billionaires in the world of oil set in the boomtowns of Texas.

videos.title: Dreamers and Losers
videos.overview: Tommy deals with the aftermath of a tragedy at the oil patch. Dynamics are disrupted when Ainsley moves into the oil house

videos.title: Hell Has a Front Yard
videos.overview: Cooper makes an impression at the oil patch. Things get complicated for Tommy when his ex-wife Angela comes to town.

videos.title: The Sting of Second Chances
videos.overview: After a rocky first impression, Rebecca comes to Tommy's defense. Cooper gets an unexpected call.

videos.title: Where Is Home
videos.overview: Tommy and his crew receive an unwelcome visit at the patch. Angela hosts family dinner at the oil house.

videos.title: Beware the Second Beating
videos.overview: Angela is caught off-guard when visiting Victor. The Norris family rallies around Cooper during his greatest time of need.

videos.title: All Roads Lead to a Hole
videos.overview: Tommy's cartel problem continues to escalate. Meanwhile, Angela and Ainsley get to know their community.

videos.title: Clumsy, This Life
videos.overview: Tommy gets connected to the National Guard. Rebecca becomes increasingly suspicious of Cooper.

videos.title: WolfCamp
videos.overview: After a health scare, Monty puts Tommy in a tough position. Cooper comes up with a plan.

videos.title: The Crumbs of Hope
videos.overview: Tommy and Cami discuss whether to gamble or play it safe. The cartel makes a move.

videos.title: Death and a Sunset
videos.overview: Tommy navigates a tense landscape as Cami asserts control.

videos.title: Sins of the Father
videos.overview: Cami is blindsided; Tommy warns Cooper about his shady entanglements.

videos.title: Almost a Home
videos.overview: Tommy confronts Cami about finances. Cooper's success draws attention.

videos.title: Dancing Rainbows
videos.overview: A tragic crash sets off a day of reckoning for the Norris family.

videos.title: The Pirate Dinner
videos.overview: Tommy juggles multiple crises as Angela throws a dinner to welcome T.L.

videos.title: Dark Night of the Soul
videos.overview: Tommy negotiates a risky offshore drilling deal as tensions rise with Cami.

videos.title: Forever Is an Instant
videos.overview: Tommy and Angela's getaway turns chaotic. Cami's plans face scrutiny.

videos.title: Handsome Touched Me
videos.overview: Tommy hires help for his father as Cami makes a risky move.

videos.title: Plans, Tears and Sirens
videos.overview: Angela rescues Ainsley. Cooper asserts his leadership at a drill site.

videos.title: Tragedy and Flies
videos.overview: Amid the chaos, Tommy regroups with Cooper.
